verdict.rationale: First-party docs show configurable provider-level failover: the gateway automatically retries other providers when one fails, `order`/`only`/`sort` in `providerOptions.gateway` set which providers are tried and in what order, and per-provider timeouts trigger fast failover. Coverage is partial because no cited item documents configuring fallback to a different model, and all evidence is vendor-claimed. missing for 10: documented configuration for fallback to a different model (beyond the generic 'manages fallbacks' mention), independent or hands-on corroboration that failover works as described.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can configure automatic fallback to another model or provider when one fails

citations.quote: Automatically retries requests to other providers if one fails
You can use `order`, `only`, and `sort` in `providerOptions.gateway` to control which providers handle your requests, in what order, and how they are ranked.
You can set per-provider timeouts to trigger fast failover when a provider is slow to respond.
The gateway sorts providers by the chosen metric and tries them in that order
AI Gateway routes requests, manages fallbacks and budgets
